name: yf_upgrades_downgrades
description:
Analyst rating changes for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance upgrades_downgrades), newest first.
Returns: {symbol, data_points (all changes), truncated, upgrades_downgrades: the limit most recent, each {GradeDate, Firm, ToGrade, FromGrade, Action (up, down, main, init, reit), priceTargetAction, currentPriceTarget, priorPriceTarget}}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-500; default 30).
Aggregate counts: yf_recommendations; target summary: yf_analyst_price_targets.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 10}
